description: src/lib.rs:471 — MAX_INTERMEDIATES as u8 triggers clippy::cast_possible_truncation. The guard assert at lib.rs:466–469 is placed after statements inside the function body, which itself triggers clippy::items_after_statements. Fix: remove the in-function const assert and replace the cast with u8::try_from(MAX_INTERMEDIATES).expect("MAX_INTERMEDIATES fits u8; see const definition"). The expect never fires at runtime because MAX_INTERMEDIATES=2, but it makes the safety argument local and eliminates both pedantic warnings.
title: [rusty/pkix-chain-simple] replace as-u8 cast with u8::try_from in verify_simple
